name: BabelDOC Dual-Column PDF
author: OmniDesk
description: Local PDF library scanner, BabelDOC dual-column translation runner, glossary locking, and bilingual spread reader.

config_schema.label: MinerU API Token
config_schema.description: 保存在密钥库，优先于 Token 文件；留空保留已有密钥

config_schema.label: MinerU API 适配器路径
config_schema.description: 留空复用学案工作台默认的 GLM-OCR/mineru_api.py；只在明确点击解析当前页时上传

config_schema.label: MinerU Token 文件路径
config_schema.description: 填写学案工作台所用账号的私有 Token 文件路径，不要填写 Token 内容；留空使用 ~/Documents/GLM-OCR/.mineru/token

config_schema.label: BabelDOC 可执行文件
config_schema.description: Command name on PATH or absolute path to the local babeldoc binary

config_schema.label: PDF 书库根目录
config_schema.description: Allowed PDF library directories (separated by ':', newline, ',', or JSON array)

config_schema.label: 双栏 PDF 输出根目录
config_schema.description: Allowed root directory for generated dual-column PDFs and page-map sidecars

config_schema.label: 默认目标语言
config_schema.description: Default target language passed to BabelDOC --lang-out (e.g. zh, zh-TW, en, ja)

config_schema.label: 任务超时（秒）
config_schema.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for a BabelDOC subprocess job
